text: A commit message trailer of the form `Adr-Exception: ADR-NNNN <reason>` must be recognized by parse_exceptions() as waiving that ADR for that change.
quote: A commit message trailer of the form `Adr-Exception: ADR-NNNN <reason>` waives that ADR for that change.

text: parse_exceptions() must accept the trailer only when a reason follows the ADR number.
quote: `parse_exceptions()` in `src/adrcheck/domain/exception.py` accepts the trailer only when a reason follows the ADR number

text: A trailer without a reason must be reported as a problem.
quote: a trailer without a reason is reported as a problem and waives nothing

text: A trailer without a reason must not waive the ADR.
quote: a trailer without a reason is reported as a problem and waives nothing

text: A waived ADR must be reported as COMPLIANT with the waiver reason shown in the report.
quote: A waived ADR is reported as COMPLIANT with the reason shown, so the waiver is visible in the report, never silent.

text: A waiver must not be applied silently; it must always be visible in the report.
quote: so the waiver is visible in the report, never silent

text: A waiver in one commit's trailer must not carry over to apply to later changes; it is scoped per commit.
quote: The trailer is per commit, so a waiver does not leak into later changes.
